front: Je me permets de vous relancer concernant ma demande du 12 mars.
pronunciation: [zhuh muh pehr-meh duh voo ruh-LAHNS kohn-sehr-nahn mah duh-mahnd dü dooz MARS]
back: I'm following up on my request of 12 March.
context: 'Relancer' = to follow up, send a reminder. 'Je me permets de' = polite opener.

front: Suite à notre conversation téléphonique, je vous adresse le devis.
pronunciation: [sweet ah noh-truh kohn-vehr-sah-syohn tay-lay-foh-NEEK, zhuh voo zah-dres luh duh-VEE]
back: Following our phone conversation, I'm sending you the quote.

front: Vous trouverez ci-joint le rapport demandé.
pronunciation: [voo troo-vuh-ray see-ZHWAN luh rah-por duh-mahn-DAY]
back: Please find attached the requested report.
context: 'Ci-joint' = attached. The standard formula for attachments.

front: Je reste à votre disposition pour tout renseignement complémentaire.
pronunciation: [zhuh rest ah voh-truh dees-poh-zee-SYOHN poor too rahn-sen-yuh-mahn kohm-play-mahn-TEHR]
back: I remain at your disposal for any further information.
context: The classic closing line of a French professional email.

front: Dans l'attente de votre retour, je vous prie d'agréer mes salutations distinguées.
pronunciation: [dahn lah-tahnt duh voh-truh ruh-TOOR, zhuh voo pree dah-gray-AY may sah-lü-tah-syohn dees-tan-GAY]
back: Looking forward to hearing from you, yours faithfully.
context: Formal letter closing. In emails, 'Cordialement' is usually enough.

front: Pourriez-vous me confirmer votre disponibilité pour jeudi ?
pronunciation: [poo-ryay-voo muh kohn-feer-may voh-truh dees-poh-nee-bee-lee-TAY poor zhuh-DEE]
back: Could you confirm your availability for Thursday?

front: Je vous propose de faire un point la semaine prochaine.
pronunciation: [zhuh voo proh-pohz duh fehr an PWAN lah suh-men proh-SHEN]
back: I suggest we catch up next week.
context: 'Faire un point' = to have a progress update meeting.

front: Quel est l'ordre du jour de la réunion ?
pronunciation: [kel eh lor-druh dü ZHOOR duh lah ray-ü-NYOHN]
back: What's on the meeting agenda?

front: Je vais vous envoyer le compte rendu de la réunion.
pronunciation: [zhuh veh voo zahn-vwah-yay luh kohnt rahn-DÜ duh lah ray-ü-NYOHN]
back: I'll send you the meeting minutes.

front: Passons au point suivant.
pronunciation: [pah-sohn oh pwan swee-VAHN]
back: Let's move on to the next item.
context: Meeting language. 'Le point suivant' = the next item.

front: Si je peux me permettre une remarque…
pronunciation: [see zhuh puh muh pehr-meh-truh ün ruh-MARK]
back: If I may make a comment…
context: Polite way to take the floor.

front: Je ne suis pas sûr de bien vous suivre.
pronunciation: [zhuh nuh swee pah sür duh byan voo SWEE-vruh]
back: I'm not sure I'm following you.

front: Pourriez-vous préciser ce point ?
pronunciation: [poo-ryay-voo pray-see-zay suh PWAN]
back: Could you clarify that point?

front: Nous devons respecter les délais.
pronunciation: [noo duh-vohn res-pek-tay lay day-LEH]
back: We must meet the deadlines.
context: 'Respecter un délai' = to meet a deadline.

front: Le projet a pris du retard.
pronunciation: [luh proh-zheh ah pree dü ruh-TAR]
back: The project has fallen behind schedule.

front: Il faudrait revoir le budget à la baisse.
pronunciation: [eel foh-dreh ruh-vwahr luh bü-zheh ah lah BES]
back: We'd need to revise the budget downwards.
context: 'Revoir à la baisse / à la hausse' = revise down / up.

front: Notre objectif est d'augmenter le chiffre d'affaires de dix pour cent.
pronunciation: [noh-truh ob-zhek-teef eh dohg-mahn-tay luh shee-fruh dah-FEHR duh dee poor SAHN]
back: Our goal is to increase turnover by ten percent.

front: Nous avons signé un contrat avec un nouveau client.
pronunciation: [noo zah-vohn see-nyay an kohn-trah ah-vek an noo-voh klee-YAHN]
back: We signed a contract with a new client.

front: Nous sommes prêts à faire un geste commercial.
pronunciation: [noo sum preh ah fehr an zhest koh-mehr-SYAL]
back: We're willing to offer a discount.
context: 'Un geste commercial' = a goodwill gesture, usually a discount.

front: C'est notre dernière offre.
pronunciation: [seh noh-truh dehr-nyehr OFR]
back: This is our final offer.

front: Pouvons-nous trouver un terrain d'entente ?
pronunciation: [poo-vohn-noo troo-vay an teh-ran dahn-TAHNT]
back: Can we find common ground?

front: Le prix est négociable selon les volumes.
pronunciation: [luh pree eh nay-goh-SYAH-bluh suh-lohn lay voh-LÜM]
back: The price is negotiable depending on volume.

front: Nous reviendrons vers vous d'ici la fin de la semaine.
pronunciation: [noo ruh-vyan-drohn vehr voo dee-see lah fan duh lah suh-MEN]
back: We'll get back to you by the end of the week.
context: 'Revenir vers quelqu'un' = to get back to someone (business French).

front: Je vous mets en copie.
pronunciation: [zhuh voo meh ahn koh-PEE]
back: I'm copying you in.

front: Pour rappel, la date limite est fixée au 30 juin.
pronunciation: [poor rah-PEL, lah daht lee-MEET eh feek-say oh trahnt ZHWAN]
back: As a reminder, the deadline is set for 30 June.
context: 'Pour rappel' = as a reminder. 'La date limite' = deadline.

front: Je suis en charge de ce dossier.
pronunciation: [zhuh swee zahn sharzh duh suh doh-SYAY]
back: I'm in charge of this file.

front: Il faut que nous validions cette proposition avec la direction.
pronunciation: [eel foh kuh noo vah-lee-dyohn set proh-poh-zee-SYOHN ah-vek lah dee-rek-SYOHN]
back: We need to get this proposal approved by management.

front: Elle a été nommée directrice des ressources humaines.
pronunciation: [el ah ay-tay noh-may dee-rek-trees day ruh-soors ü-MEN]
back: She was appointed head of human resources.

front: Nous recrutons un chef de projet en CDI.
pronunciation: [noo ruh-krü-tohn an shef duh proh-ZHEH ahn say-day-EE]
back: We're hiring a project manager on a permanent contract.

front: Le salaire est à négocier selon l'expérience.
pronunciation: [luh sah-lehr eh tah nay-goh-syay suh-lohn lek-spay-RYAHNS]
back: The salary is negotiable depending on experience.

front: Je souhaiterais évoquer une augmentation de salaire.
pronunciation: [zhuh sweh-tuh-reh ay-voh-kay ün ohg-mahn-tah-syohn duh sah-LEHR]
back: I'd like to discuss a salary increase.

front: Mon entretien annuel est prévu le mois prochain.
pronunciation: [mohn nahn-truh-tyan ah-nü-EL eh pray-vü luh mwah proh-SHAN]
back: My annual review is scheduled for next month.

front: Il faut savoir prendre des initiatives.
pronunciation: [eel foh sah-vwahr prahn-druh day zee-nee-syah-TEEV]
back: You need to know how to take initiative.

front: Je vous remercie de votre réactivité.
pronunciation: [zhuh voo ruh-mehr-SEE duh voh-truh ray-ak-tee-vee-TAY]
back: Thank you for your quick response.
context: 'La réactivité' = responsiveness: a favorite business word.

front: Toutes mes excuses pour ce retard de réponse.
pronunciation: [toot may zek-SKÜZ poor suh ruh-tar duh ray-POHNS]
back: My apologies for this late reply.

front: Nous avons bien reçu votre candidature.
pronunciation: [noo zah-vohn byan ruh-sü voh-truh kahn-dee-dah-TÜR]
back: We have received your application.

front: Malheureusement, votre profil ne correspond pas à nos besoins actuels.
pronunciation: [mah-luh-ruhz-MAHN, voh-truh proh-FEEL nuh koh-res-pohn pah ah noh buh-zwan zak-TÜ-EL]
back: Unfortunately, your profile doesn't match our current needs.
context: The standard rejection letter. 'Actuel' = current (false friend).

front: Nous allons délocaliser une partie de la production.
pronunciation: [noo zah-lohn day-loh-kah-lee-zay ün par-tee duh lah proh-dük-SYOHN]
back: We're going to relocate part of production abroad.

front: L'entreprise a réalisé un bénéfice record.
pronunciation: [lahn-truh-preez ah ray-ah-lee-zay an bay-nay-fees ruh-KOR]
back: The company made a record profit.

front: La société a été rachetée par un groupe américain.
pronunciation: [lah soh-syay-TAY ah ay-tay rahsh-tay par an groop ah-may-ree-KAN]
back: The company was bought by an American group.

front: Il faut savoir dire non sans froisser l'interlocuteur.
pronunciation: [eel foh sah-vwahr deer NOHN sahn frwah-say lan-tehr-loh-kü-TUHR]
back: You need to know how to say no without offending the other person.
context: 'Froisser' = to offend (literally to crease). 'L'interlocuteur' = the person you're dealing with.

front: Je vous laisse revenir vers moi si besoin.
pronunciation: [zhuh voo les ruh-vuh-neer vehr MWAH see buh-ZWAN]
back: Feel free to get back to me if needed.

front: Merci par avance pour votre aide.
pronunciation: [mehr-SEE par ah-vahns poor voh-truh ED]
back: Thank you in advance for your help.

front: Ce poste implique de nombreux déplacements.
pronunciation: [suh post an-pleek duh nohm-bruh day-plas-MAHN]
back: This position involves a lot of travel.

front: Le séminaire aura lieu à Bordeaux les 3 et 4 octobre.
pronunciation: [luh say-mee-nehr oh-rah lyuh ah bor-DOH lay trwah ay kah-truh ok-TOH-bruh]
back: The seminar will take place in Bordeaux on 3 and 4 October.
